name: print-social-painterly-lily-pond-digital-illustration
title: Painterly lily pond with lime lily pads, blue water and two small flowers
whatItIs: A flat-perspective digital painting of a pond filled with overlapping lily pads in lime, teal and olive, deep blue water shapes, a white and a blue water lily, orange floating leaves and loose brush marks.
whatItMeans: Calm and lush; saturated flat shapes feel like a modern take on Monet.
techniques: Build a scene from overlapping flat shapes.
Use a top-down view to make pattern out of nature.
Add two small flowers as focal accents.

vocabulary.definition: Looking straight down on a scene.
